data.narrative:
HyImpulse is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised €74 million to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 4 private peers at similar stages (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse), with an additional 5 public space and aerospace equities available for sector context.

Two valuation methods were applicable. The stage-progression approach, using the €74 million total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of €141 million. The peer-median method anchors to the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables, which traded at a median valuation of €1.6 billion, with a range from €1.1 billion (Skyryse) to €8.0 billion (Sierra Space). The public-comp P/S anchoring method was not applicable, as HyImpulse's revenue is not disclosed. A third triangulation point using public equities was precluded by the absence of target revenue data.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of €120 million (low) to €1.9 billion (high), with a median of €895 million. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around HyImpulse's market position relative to peer cohort heterogeneity—particularly the €8 billion outlier (Sierra Space, Series C). Resolution of this range will depend on clarifying HyImpulse's development stage relative to Series C peers and revenue trajectory relative to disclosed comparables.
